methods.name: add_offset
methods.signature: fn add_offset(&mut self, offset: isize) -> Result<()>
methods.summary: Adds `offset` value to the index of each expression inside this ordering equivalence class.

methods.name: add_orderings
methods.signature: fn add_orderings(&mut self, sort_exprs: impl IntoIterator<Item = impl IntoIterator<Item = PhysicalSortExpr>>)
methods.summary: Adds new orderings into this ordering equivalence class.

methods.name: extend
methods.signature: fn extend(&mut self, orderings: impl IntoIterator<Item = LexOrdering>)
methods.summary: Extend this ordering equivalence class with the given orderings.

methods.name: get_options
methods.summary: Gets sort options associated with this expression if it is a leading ordering expression. Otherwise, returns `None`.

methods.name: is_expr_partial_const
methods.summary: Checks whether the given expression is partially constant according to this ordering equivalence class.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(orderings: impl IntoIterator<Item = impl IntoIterator<Item = PhysicalSortExpr>>) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates a new ordering equivalence class from the given orderings and removes any redundant entries (if given).

methods.name: output_ordering
methods.summary: Returns the concatenation of all the orderings. This enables merge operations to preserve all equivalent orderings simultaneously.

methods.name: with_new_schema
